svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot tubes (make 2): 20 mm outside, 13 mm bore, 31 mm long. Deburr

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bore. Grease the outside before fitting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers: two tubes 30 mm outside, 20 mm bore, 5 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each side, from the middle: tube through the arm, spacer, rear hanger;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an M12 bolt through the bore with a 30 mm washer and a nyloc nut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside the hanger. The two sides are mirror images; the middle is open.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The arms must turn freely on the tubes; the bolts clamp the hangers only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each arm swings by hand through its full travel.
